title: Harnessing the neutral Ca(NO3)2 electrolyte in CaMnO3 perovskite systems for calcium-ion supercapacitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17450-17461
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01178K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abhirami Sukumaran, Helen Annal Therese
Hydrothermally synthesised CaMnO3 with neutral Ca(NO3)2 electrolyte exhibited 258 F g−1 at 0.5 A g−1 within a potential of 1.9 V and showed 72.6% capacitance retention after 1500 cycles. The symmetric device delivered 76.1 F g−1 and powered a yellow LED.
